visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a black tiger-print bomber jacket and olive green pants stands in a public park area on a rainy day. He is animatedly performing a speech, with his arms wide open and a determined facial expression. Standing opposite him is actor Sylvester Stallone, dressed in a dark purple blazer over a black sweater. A man in a grey jacket and yellow beanie holds a black umbrella over Stallone to protect him from the light rain. (2) The camera remains at a medium-wide shot as the boy continues his energetic recitation, pointing his finger towards Stallone and moving his body in a rhythmic, boxing-like manner. Stallone watches with a serious yet supportive expression, leaning forward slightly to hear better. In the background, a small crowd of onlookers stands behind a black metal fence, some holding up smartphones to record the interaction. (3) The boy concludes his speech with high intensity, raising his arms and puffing out his chest in a triumphant stance. Stallone smiles and acknowledges the boy's performance with a gesture of his hand. The setting is characterized by wet pavement and bare winter trees under an overcast, grey sky.
